title: Reagan proposes SDI at a cabinet meeting

tellings.quote: >> And he said, "Look, wouldn't it be wonderful at a cabinet meeting if we could design something that would protect us from missiles?"

plain: John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy, says he was at a 1983 cabinet meeting where President Ronald Reagan first floated the idea behind SDI, the Strategic Defense Initiative, a plan to defend the United States against missiles. According to Herrington, Reagan said, "Look, wouldn't it be wonderful if we could design something that would protect us from missiles?" He tells Michels this as someone who was in the room.
